entries.zh: 下围棋；弈棋（西语词头作“下棋”，此处泛指对弈盘戏）
entries.en: to play weiqi (go); (the Spanish headword says "to play chess", used generically for board games)
entries.notes: R 栏作“alaytabla”，疑为西语旁注（a la tabla，棋盘）而非官话对音；H 首字有[疑:圍/圖]。

entries.zh: 下棋；走棋（落子对弈）
entries.en: to play chess; to make a move at chess

entries.zh: 玩来玩去；四处游玩、玩个不停
entries.en: to go about playing; to be forever playing about
entries.notes: H 第二字[疑:未/來]，M 作 lay，与“來”合。

entries.zh: 玩双陆（掷骰行子的盘戏，近似西洋双陆棋）
entries.en: to play backgammon (shuanglu, a dice-and-board game)

entries.zh: 掷骰子；玩骰子
entries.en: to throw dice; to play at dice

entries.zh: 打陀螺（抽陀螺）
entries.en: to play with a spinning top; to whip a top

entries.zh: 打球；玩球
entries.en: to play ball

entries.zh: 打棉球（用棉布缝制的球）
entries.en: to play with a cotton ball (a ball of cotton cloth)
entries.notes: H 有[疑:綿/錦]，M 作 my，与“綿”合。

entries.zh: 泼水玩；拍水嬉戏
entries.en: to play in the water, splashing about
entries.notes: M 并列两读（bag chuy / boa），“bag”与“抹”常读不合。

entries.zh: 打弹珠；玩子仔（击小石、小球之戏）
entries.en: to play marbles (shooting small balls or stones)

entries.zh: 舞棍嬉戏；持木棍比划对打（戏拟击剑）
entries.en: to play at fencing with sticks; to spar with poles in play
entries.notes: H 第三字[疑:棔/棍]，M 末二音 tuy/cuy 不能与汉字确配，语义据 L。

entries.zh: 舞狮（翻腾戏狮）
entries.en: to perform the lion dance (tumbling the lion)

entries.zh: 玩“葫芦问”（走子盘戏，与西语“鹅棋”同类）
entries.en: to play the game of the goose (a Chinese board game of the same type)

entries.zh: 玩纸牌；打牌
entries.en: to play cards

entries.zh: 玩牙牌（骨牌，铺排牌张的牌戏）
entries.en: to play dominoes (laying out Chinese domino tiles)

entries.zh: 代人下注赌钱（替人赌，输赢分账）
entries.en: to gamble on another's behalf, sharing the stakes
entries.notes: H 有[疑:帮/幫]，M 中“guiau”与“賭”音不合。

entries.zh: 行酒令（席间行令以定谁饮酒）
entries.en: to play the drinking game (to call the forfeit that decides who drinks)

entries.zh: 酒令；行酒令
entries.en: the wine forfeit game; to play at drinking forfeits

entries.zh: 玩“打陆”（走子盘戏，近于跳棋）
entries.en: to play draughts (checkers); a board game of the backgammon-checkers kind
entries.notes: “打陸”为盘戏名，西语 damas（跳棋）系近义借用，非同名对译。

entries.zh: 投壶（掷箭入壶的古戏）
entries.en: to play pitch-pot (throwing arrows into a pot)

entries.zh: 耍妖术；弄法术（妄言行术）
entries.en: to practise sorcery; to play at magic
entries.notes: 西语词头“magi corul”疑讹（当作 magia）；M 末二音 jia cau 未能确配。

entries.zh: 有法术能变化；会施术变形
entries.en: to have magic power and be able to transform
entries.notes: H 有[疑:变/變]；M 的 ey/gy 与“能/变”常读不合。
